plainText:
Arman (Japanese: アーマン Āman) is an that Henry Sword owns in Pokémon Adventures and his sixth overall. It was given to Henry by Mustard.

==In the manga==
===History===
====With Mustard====
Urshifu debuted in Boom!! Reunion in a New Land as a . Mustard introduced Kubfu to , hoping she would help it see the world outside the Master Dojo and overcome its shy nature. Casey rejected the offer as she already had a full party, so Mustard instead passed the task onto Henry. In Whoosh!! To the Forest of Focus, Kubfu traveled with Henry to the Forest of Focus to look for tree sap capable of curing the effects of 's poison. As soon as they arrived, the group was attacked by some rampaging Pokémon. Kubfu impulsively fought off the Pokémon, only to retreat in shame when Klara pointed out the Pokémon didn't actually mean any harm. 
 
In BAAM!! Incredible Evolution of the Three Pokémon, once the sap was collected, Kubfu stole the container from Casey, hoping to use it to cure a . After scolding Kubfu for failing to explain itself, the group suggested it use a Pecha Berry as a substitute, only to earn the anger of a group of led by a . Twiggy, Bit, and Sniffler fended off the group, giving Kubfu the opportunity to heal the Zorua. Afterward, Kubfu trained by battling various wild Pokémon on the island.
 
In Bom Bom!! Kubfu and Intense Training, Henry and the others came across the Tower of Darkness while searching for the Rusted Sword and Shield. A guarding the entrance refused to let them enter the building unless Henry and Kubfu defeat her in a one-on-one battle. Despite landing the first blow, Kubfu was quickly defeated by the student's . Later that night, Kubfu went to investigate the tower by itself, only to be taken out by an unseen Pokémon.

In Rrmbll!! Serious Tower Battle, Kubfu chose to challenge the Tower of Waters. After battling through various students, Henry and Kubfu reached the final floor, where they faced Mustard and his Urshifu. By targeting Urshifu's feet, Kubfu forced it to stumble, leaving Urshifu wide open to be defeated by a powerful . Mustard allowed Kubfu to examine the Scroll of Waters, causing it to evolve into a Urshifu. With their training complete, Mustard suggested Henry permanently keep Urshifu on his team, which he accepted.

====With Henry====
Henry and Urshifu reunited with Casey and Marvin at Loop Lagoon. Casey managed to track down the Rusted Shield, only for it to be guarded by a . With assistance from Hop, Henry was able to retrieve the shield, only for Moltres to carry him away to the Crown Tundra.

In Craaash!! Triple March, Hop returned Urshifu to Henry, who saved him from an attack from . Henry then nicknamed him Arman. 

===Personality and characteristics===
 
 
While living with Mustard, Kubfu was the "secret armor" of the Master Dojo. However, its potential was stunted by shyness, causing it to hide behind people's legs and refuse to leave the dojo. Once it left the dojo and explored the Isle of Armor, it began to gain more confidence in itself, defending people instead of hiding away and standing up for what it wanted. Near the end of its training it had even gained enough confidence to be on its own, shown when it entered the Tower of Waters on its own in order to prove itself. It has also been shown to be a kind Pokémon, acting on impulse to help an injured .

Unlike the rest of Henry's team, Arman does not use a tool, though Henry has related its ability to protect others like an armor as a tool in and of itself.
 

===Appearance===
 

===Moves used===
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==In the games==
Urshifu is Mustard's main Pokémon, being used in all but his initial battle. It is capable of Gigantamaxing. It evolves into the Rapid Strike Style if the player chooses the Tower of Darkness.

===As an opponent===
 

====Gives away====
Mustard gives this Kubfu to the player once they have cleared his three trials.

 

==In the TCG==
This listing is of cards mentioning or featuring Mustard's Urshifu in the Pokémon Trading Card Game.

 
 
 
 

==Trivia==
Arman is Henry's only Pokémon that:
Does not use a physical tool.
Has not been seen in a Dynamaxed or Gigantamaxed state.

==Names==
